title: Marketing automation and email
for: campaigns, flows and journeys, audiences and segments, email performance

manual.export: Open the campaign or email performance report in the tool, export it as CSV (most tools have Export on the report or campaign list page) and drop the file into the snapshots folder.

vendors.name: HubSpot Marketing Hub
caveats: Same server as the CRM row (server name `hubspot`); one .mcp.json entry serves both categories
Read tools: get_marketing_email_analytics, get_content_analytics_report, get_campaign_attribution_reports; deny mcp__hubspot__manage_* unless writes are wanted
The vendor page documents https://mcp.hubspot.com; Claude Code examples elsewhere use https://mcp.hubspot.com/anthropic; confirm the path when wiring
Publishing an email or page through manage_* is a user-visible action; humans decide (AGENTS.md rule 3)

auth.where: browser grant on first use; scopes follow the HubSpot user's permissions

cli.notes: developer tooling for CMS and apps; it does not export marketing analytics

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; a private-app token reads /marketing/v3/emails/statistics/list for a scheduled email-performance snapshot

vendors.name: Marketo (Adobe)
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__marketo`) until checked
100+ operations, most of them writes (create programs, campaigns, emails, forms); no read-only mode is documented
Credentials travel as per-request headers, so the entry uses ${MARKETO_CLIENT_ID}, ${MARKETO_CLIENT_SECRET} and ${MARKETO_MUNCHKIN_ID} placeholders; an IMS bearer token is the alternative
Smart List and Smart Campaign create/update were slated for September 2026; check the changelog

auth.where: Marketo: Admin > Integration > LaunchPoint (custom service) for the client id and secret; Admin > Munchkin for the Munchkin id

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the same LaunchPoint credentials mint a REST token for the bulk activity export endpoints

vendors.name: Customer.io
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__customerio`) until checked
Writes (campaigns, segments, broadcasts) arrived in Spring 2026; a broadcast is a send, so it is a humans-decide action
An account admin enables the MCP server once for the workspace; EU workspaces use https://mcp-eu.customer.io/mcp
Listed in the Claude connectors directory

auth.where: browser grant on first use, after an admin enables MCP in Workspace Settings
browser grant on first use (EU data center)

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; an App API key (Settings > API Credentials) reads /v1/campaigns/{id}/metrics for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Braze
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__braze`) until checked
Early access: an admin grants the 'Use MCP Server' permission per user; the older local beta server is deprecated
Writes cover templates, Content Blocks and media, not sends; no user-profile PII is exposed
EU clusters use https://mcp.braze.eu/mcp

auth.where: browser grant on first use (dynamic client registration, SSO supported)
browser grant on first use (EU cluster)

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; a REST API key with campaigns.data_series reads /campaigns/data_series on the cluster's REST endpoint

vendors.name: Klaviyo
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__klaviyo`) until checked, or run the local variant with READ_ONLY=true which is pinned below
The remote server is OAuth-only; the local variant with a private API key is the headless path and honours READ_ONLY
Only Owner, Admin and Manager roles can connect
Listed in the Claude connectors directory

auth.where: browser grant on first use (dynamic client registration)
Klaviyo: Settings > Account > API keys (private key with read scopes)

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the private key reads /api/campaign-values-reports for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Mailchimp
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__mandrill`) until checked
The only official server is for Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill): nine developer tools, none for audiences or campaign reports
The Marketing API (audiences, campaigns, reports) has no official server; community servers (pipeworx, cyanheads) and the generic connectors are the alternatives; judge a community server as a script
Mandrill auth model not verified on the vendor page; expect an API key

auth.where: Mandrill: Settings > SMTP & API Info; header format assumed, confirm on the vendor page

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the Marketing API key (Account > Extras > API keys) reads /3.0/reports for a scheduled campaign-performance snapshot; this is the practical route for audiences and campaigns

vendors.name: ActiveCampaign
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__activecampaign`) until checked

The vendor documents OAuth setup through the Claude and ChatGPT connector flows (developers.activecampaign.com/page/connect-claude) but does not print a raw endpoint URL; no .mcp.json entry until a person reads it from the connect page
Listed in the Claude connectors directory for Claude and Claude Code, which is the easiest way in
The Postmark server (ActiveCampaign/postmark-mcp, transactional stats) is a separate product

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the account API key (Settings > Developer) reads /api/3/campaigns for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Brevo
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__brevo`) until checked
The token is an API key generated with the MCP option (Brevo: SMTP & API > API keys); the docs show it as Authorization: Bearer
Per-module servers exist beside the all-modules URL; the all-modules one is wired here
Sending a campaign is a humans-decide action

auth.where: Brevo: SMTP & API > API keys > Generate with the MCP option

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; a v3 API key reads /v3/emailCampaigns with statistics for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Iterable
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__iterable`) until checked
Beta and open source; Iterable says it may change or be discontinued

The package prefers keys managed by `npx @iterable/mcp keys add` (stored in the OS keychain); ITERABLE_API_KEY in the environment is the documented alternative and the one wired here; ITERABLE_BASE_URL selects the EU endpoint

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the same key reads /api/campaigns/metrics for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Intercom
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__intercom`) until checked
Mostly read; the writes are Help Center article create and update
US-hosted workspaces only
Listed in the Claude connectors directory

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; an access token from a private app (Developer Hub) reads /conversations/search for a scheduled snapshot

vendors.name: Resend
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__resend`) until checked
Sending email is an irreversible write: deny the send tools by name once known, and keep sends behind human approval
The remote server takes OAuth or an API key as a bearer token; the local package resend-mcp needs RESEND_API_KEY

auth.where: Resend: API Keys (a key with sending access is a send key; create a read-only one where the workflow only reads)

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the key reads /broadcasts for a scheduled snapshot
